finding.title: Add semantic labels to the icon-only ArrowButton carousel controls (AX-3)
finding.why: The prev/next chevrons that page the active-tracks carousel are pure Icon-in-InkWell controls with no Semantics/tooltip/semanticLabel anywhere in the widget or its two call sites (prev at line 79, next at line 94 of active_tracks_carousel_section.dart). A TalkBack/VoiceOver user hears at best an unlabeled 'button' for each — no indication of direction or purpose — for the only pointer-driven way to move between active tracks. dashboard_body.dart:304-311 shows the team applying this exact fix elsewhere ('F-11: wrap the streak chip in a Semantics node so TalkBack/VoiceOver announces a descriptive label'), so the omission here is an inconsistency, not a policy gap.
finding.recommendation: Wrap each ArrowButton instance (or give the widget a required semanticLabel) in Semantics(label: l10n.previousTrack / l10n.nextTrack, button: true, excludeSemantics: true, ...), mirroring the streak-chip pattern in dashboard_body.dart.
acceptance_criteria: A widget test using tester.getSemantics on ActiveTracksCarouselSection confirms both arrow controls expose a non-empty, direction-specific label.
Manual TalkBack/VoiceOver pass announces 'Previous track'/'Next track' (EN) and their Hebrew ARB equivalents.
